integrity: Complete analytic proof and self-contained finite checker. Finite checks do not substitute for proofs of the infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns ordered residue-class pairs modulo powers of seven. It does not address positive-integer representations or other prime moduli; the limiting local density diverges at the measure-zero point zero. A broader unindexed p-adic theorem may cover some part of the result.
title: Exact 7-adic fibre law and a sharp third-moment obstruction for sums of two cubes
